versions.changelog:
- Updated the "display_name" field in SKILL.md from 旅行规划师 Travel Planner to Travel Planner.
- No changes to any logic/code, only metadata/documentation updated.

- Initial release of Travel Planner (version 1.0.0) powered by Amap path planning API.
- Provides comprehensive travel lifecycle planning: destination research, itinerary design, budget management, and checklists, all based on real driving/walking/transit data.
- Generates accurate time, distance, and route details for each trip segment, replacing rough estimates.
- Outputs a travel map as a QR code for direct viewing and navigation in the Amap app.
- Features food search, travel tips, and itinerary optimization based on live map data.
- Seamless integration with Amap Web Services; requires AMAP_API_KEY setup.
